case_number: 2024 INSC 14; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 9133 OF 2019; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 787 OF 2020

parties.respondent: Ruchi Soya Industries Limited and Another

summary: Interpretation of amended Section 30(2)(b)(ii) IBC; dissenting financial creditor's entitlement to liquidation value of security interest; pari passu vs security-specific treatment; amendment applied retroactively via Explanation 2; NCLT/NCLAT dismissal challenged; escrow amount maintained pending appeal; liquidation value determination; security interest valuation method.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Act, 2019 s.6
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of; interim order regarding escrow amount maintained; parties directed to appear before NCLAT.
